transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Ever since they changed everything at school, I feel like I’m not handling it well at all and my reactions to the stress are taking over my life. It just feels like too much, and I don't know how to cope with it anymore.
Did these symptoms start within a month of the school change, or have you been feeling anxious and overwhelmed for at least six months?

It started very quickly, within just a few weeks of them announcing the restructuring and moving me to the new classroom. I have been feeling this way for about five months now, ever since those changes were rolled out.
Have these stress-related feelings made it hard for you to keep up with school, relationships, or daily activities?

Yes, it has completely disrupted my life. My lesson planning has slowed down so much that I'm staying up late every night just to keep up, and my principal even noticed that I seem disengaged in class. At home, I'm so drained and irritable that I've been skipping family get-togethers and barely talking to my husband.
Have you had any thoughts of hurting yourself, or do you feel hopeless most of the time because of these school changes?
No, I don't have any thoughts of hurting myself at all. But I do feel incredibly overwhelmed, drained, and stressed by all the changes at school, and it feels like it is taking over everything.
Have there been any other major stressors or losses around the same time, or is this mainly tied to the school restructuring?

No, there isn't anything else going on; this is entirely tied to the massive changes at my school. It's just the overwhelming stress of losing my bilingual classroom, dealing with the rigid new curriculum, and feeling so isolated after my close colleagues retired or transferred.
Have your symptoms been improving at all as you’ve adjusted to the school changes, or do they still feel just as intense now as when they started?

No, they haven't improved at all and still feel just as intense as when this all started five months ago. I feel like I'm on a constant emotional roller coaster every single day with absolutely no relief from this work-related tension. It just doesn't seem to let up.
